# `<sbrk.h>`

Program break for the heap allocator.

```c
#include <sbrk.h>
```

## Structures

### `Arena` { #arena }

An arena: a buffer and how much of it is used. The heap's reservation and current break.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base` | `uint8_t *` | Start of the buffer. |
| `size` | `size_t` | Buffer size in bytes. |
| `offset` | `size_t` | Bytes handed out so far. |
| `base` | [`VirtAddr`](../types.md#virtaddr) | Start of the reservation. |
| `brk` | [`VirtAddr`](../types.md#virtaddr) | Current break. |
| `mapped` | [`VirtAddr`](../types.md#virtaddr) | End of the reservation. |

## Functions

### `sbrk` { #sbrk }

```c
void * sbrk(intptr_t incr);
```

Moves the program break by `incr` bytes.

The first call reserves 32 MiB of anonymous memory, filled on demand; the break moves within that reservation only.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `incr` | in | Bytes to grow by, or a negative number to shrink by. |

**Returns:** The previous break, or (void *)-1 if the reservation cannot be made or the break would leave it.
